create_EMAState_from_model: create an EMAState object from a PyTorch model using the FromModel class method
update_model_with_EMAUpdater: update a model's exponential moving average using EMAUpdater with a specified decay rate
apply_ema_weights_to_model: apply EMA weights to a model and optionally restore the original weights afterward
configure_model_ema_in_detectron2: add MODEL_EMA configuration options to a Detectron2 config object using add_model_ema_configs
use_EMAHook_for_training: attach an EMAHook to a Detectron2 training loop to update EMA weights after each step
